Mediales Kompartiment:
Geringe hyperintense Signalalteration in der medialen Femurcondyle (Serie 5/ Image 18). Ansonsten regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Innenmeniskus. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Ausdünnung des Knorpels in der Belastungszone der lateralen Femurcondyle. Kein fokal tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Diskretes Knochenödem am Patellaunterpol (Serie 1015/ Image 43). Ansonsten regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Fokal tendinopathische Auftreibung der  Patellarsehne gelenkseitig mit in Korrelation zu dem Summationsbild vom [DATE] konstant abgrenzbaren, kleinen eingelagerten Ossikeln. Verdacht auf winzige Partialläsion der Sehne (Serie 5/ Image 7). Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizepssehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. Fabella.

Central supporting system 
  Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): preserved.  
  Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): preserved. 
  Anterior tibial translation: none.  
  
 Medial compartment  
  Normal marrow SI of medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau are preserved.  
  Partial thickness cartilaginous loss at anteromedial aspect of femoral condyle, measured about intact4 cm in length, without subchondral bone edema is seen. 
  Medial meniscus: preserved.  
  Mixoid degeneration of posterior horn of medial meniscus is seen. 
  Medial collateral ligament: preserved.  
  Medial gastrocnemius: preserved.  
  Semimenbranosus tendon: preserved.  
  Semitendinosus tendon: preserved.  
  
 Lateral compartment  
  Normal marrow SI of lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau are preserved.  
  Preservation of cartilage at weightbaring lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau.  
  Lateral meniscus: preserved.  
  Lateral collateral ligament: preserved.  
  Popliteus tendon: preserved.  
  Poplitiofibular ligament: preserved.  
  Posterior meniscofemoral ligament: preserved 
  Biceps femoris: preserved.  
  Iliotibial band: Intact.  
  Lateral gastrocnemius: intact.  
  Tibiofibular joint: unremarkable.  
  
 Patellofemoral joint  
  Preserve normal marrow SI within patella.  
  Quadriceps tendon: intact  
  Patella tendon: intact within normal alignment.  
  Medial and lateral patellofemoral retinaculum: preserved.  
  Mild subcutaneous edema at prepatella region is noted. 
  
 Others  
  Cystic lesion between semimembranosus tendon and medial head of gastrocnimious tendon is found, measured 1.5xintact5 cm; suggesting small Baker cyst.  
  No definite synovial plica is noted.  
  Minimal effusion within knee joint is observed.  
  Muscles appear unremarkable.  
  Neurovascular bundles are intact.   No evidence of meniscus tear.  
  No evidence of central supporting system injury. 
  Partial thickness cartilaginous loss at anteromedial aspect of femoral condyle (intact4 cm in length).  
  Mixoid degeneration of posterior horn of medial meniscus. 
  Suggested small Baker cyst (1.5xintact5 cm).

Small suprapatellar effusion, a cluster of variably sized ossific loose bodies is appreciated posteromedially, the largest on measuring just over 1 cm across.

The medial meniscus appears intact.  
There is incomplete, chronic looking loss of lateral meniscal tissue throughout the corresponding posterior half, together with diffuse full-thickness chondral loss affecting the lateral tibial plateau.
No displaced meniscal fragments are present. 

Focal grade 3 chondral loss noted at the medial retropatellar facets, relatively mild age-related thinning of medial weightbearing hyaline cartilage.
There are nonetheless medial and lateral femorotibial marginal osteophytes.
Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus musculotendinous unit, distal iliotibial band and the patellar tendon.
Chronic looking calcific, quiescent distal insertional quadriceps tendinosis.
No fracture or marrow infiltration.
Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

MRI ΔΕΞΙΟΥ ΓΟΝΑΤΟΣ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗ Η εξέταση έγινε με ακολουθίες παλμών Τ1,Τ2, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων με καταστολή του σήματος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθμιδωτής ηχούς. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ Ενδοαρθρικά σημειούται σημαντική συλλογή υγρού. Ο έσω μηνίσκος παρουσιάζει παθολογικό σήμα κατά το οπίσθιο κέρας αυτού, με μετατόπιση μηνισκικού τμήματος κατά τη μεσογλήνια εντομή. Επίσης μετατοπισθέν τεμάχιο παρατηρείται κατά το πρόσθιο κέρας αυτού. Ο έξω μηνίσκος, ο οπίσθιος χιαστός και ο έξω πλάγιος σύνδεσμος απεικονίζονται εντός του φυσιολογικού. Ο έσω πλάγιος σύνδεσμος παρουσιάζει οίδημα πέριξ αυτού. Ο πρόσθιος χιαστός σύνδεσμος παρουσιάζει οίδημα και μεγάλου βαθμού ασυνέχεια κατά την εγγύς μοίρα του. Συλλογή υγρού παρατηρείται προεπιγονατιδικά. Ο αρθρικός χόνδρος έχει φυσιολογική απεικόνιση. Συμπέρασμα: 1. Υφολική ρήξη προσθίου χιαστού συνδέσμου με ύδραρθρο. 2. Ρήξη έσω μηνίσκου δίκην λαβής κάδου (bucket handle) καθώς και ρήξη και μετατόπιση του πρόσθιου κέρατος αυτού. 3. Μικρή εστία οστικού μώλωπα κατά τον έξω μηριαίο κόνδυλο. 4. Μικρή συλλογή προεπιγονατιδικά αντιστοιχεί σε ήπια κάκωση Morel-Lavallee. 5. Μερική κάκωση έσω πλάγιου συνδέσμου (grade I).

In the medial compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior root of the medial meniscus. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the medial gutter. There is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring, non weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is subchondral edema. Few subchondral bone cysts (about intact3intact4 cm) are identified. Osteophytes are present.  
  
 The lateral compartment, there is incomplete discoid lateral meniscus without tear. The articular cartilage appears normal.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial, lateral patellar facets, medial and lateral trochleas. There is no subchondral edema. Small osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Medial tibiofemoral and mild patellofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the left knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, cysts and osteophytes. 
  Radial tear at the posterior root of the medial meniscus. (note: meniscal extrusion into the medial gutter). 
  Incomplete discoid lateral meniscus without tear.  
  Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis.

Findings:  There is a minor knee effusion. There is a complex tear of the posterior horn and posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Evidence of patellofemoral syndrome and maltracking. Patella alta, with prominent edema in the superolateral Hoffa fat pad and prefemoral fat pad in keeping with fat pad impingement. Diffuse patellar tendinosis with surrounding edema and low-grade intrasubstance tears proximally.
